vintage: EIA-930 Hourly Electric Grid Monitor, 2026-07-01 to 2026-11-27
rule: Territories are approximate: each hex goes to the grid operator (balancing authority) that registered the most operating capacity in it in EIA-860M; hexes without plants take the nearest operator. EIA's own boundary layer is not public. Flows are EIA-930 interchange between directly connected operators (positive = first operator exports to the second); both sides' reports are averaged.
